STEERING — Power Steering (Power Steering Pump)

[First diagram showing inscribed mark location]
Inscribed Mark
SR1510

If necessary, replace the valve with one having the same letter as on the front housing.
Inscribed mark: A, B, C, D, E or F

4. INSPECT FLOW CONTROL VALVE SPRING
Using a scale, measure the free length of the spring.
Free length: 37 — 39 mm (1.46 — 1.54 in.)
If the free length is not within specification, replace the spring.

[Second diagram showing spring measurement]
SD0044

5. IF NECESSARY, REPLACE OIL SEAL
(a) Using a screwdriver, pry out the snap ring.

[Third diagram showing snap ring removal]
SR1511

(b) Using a screwdriver, pry out the oil seal.

[Fourth diagram showing oil seal removal]
SR1512

(c) Using a 22 mm socket wrench, press in a new oil seal.
(d) Coat the oil seal lip with MP grease.

[Fifth diagram showing oil seal installation]
SR1513
